name: Have you considered the appropriate Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) profile for all the components of the service?
conditionsText:
Applies when:
- Designing the service architecture.
- Selecting controls.
- Planning assurance activities.
- Determining security requirements.
requirementTitle: Have you considered the appropriate Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) profile for all the components of the service?
requirementDescription: Have you worked out what level of assurance and security expectations apply to each part of the service based on its risk and importance?
why: Different components may require different levels of security.
tasks: Have you considered the appropriate Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) profile for all the components of the service?

actions.title: Have you considered the appropriate Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) profile for all the components of the service?
actions.description: Assess each major service component, appropriate CAF expectations, traceability, provide evidence in CAF assessment, security architecture documents etc
